title: 7-Day Zanzibar Island Package
bestTimeToGo: June to October for dry season; also excellent December to February
highlights: Prison Island giant tortoises and Nakupenda sandbank with seafood lunch
Swim with dolphins and turtles at Mnemba Island and Baraka Aquarium
Jozani National Park, The Rock Restaurant, and Kuza Cave
Full-day Safari Blue cruise with seafood lunch
Stone Town city tour and spice farm visit with Swahili dinner
All airport transfers and ground transportation included
includes: All entrance fees and activity costs
Meals as specified in itinerary (seafood lunches, Swahili dinner)
Boat transfers for all water activities

itinerary.dayBody: Arrive at Karume International Airport in Zanzibar. Our team meets you at arrivals and transfers you directly to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to settle in, explore the hotel grounds, and enjoy the beach.

A full day of island exploration. Board a boat to Prison Island where you’ll meet the giant Aldabra tortoises, some over 100 years old. Then cruise to the stunning Nakupenda sandbank — a strip of white sand in the middle of the ocean — for a fresh seafood lunch prepared right on the beach.

An early start for a magical day. Head out to sea near Mnemba Island to swim with wild dolphins. Afterwards, snorkel the pristine reefs around Mnemba Atoll. The day continues with a visit to the Baraka Natural Aquarium where you can swim with sea turtles in crystal-clear water.

itinerary.dayTitle: Day 4 — Jozani Forest, Rock Restaurant & Kuza Cave
itinerary.dayBody: Explore Jozani National Park, home to the rare Zanzibar red colobus monkey. Continue to the iconic Rock Restaurant, perched on a rock in the ocean, for a memorable lunch. Finish the day visiting the fascinating Kuza Cave and the charming village of Jambiani.

A full day aboard a traditional dhow for the legendary Safari Blue experience. Sail through turquoise waters, relax on pristine sandbanks, snorkel over coral reefs, and swim in the lagoon. Enjoy a lavish fresh seafood lunch prepared on Kwale Island beach.

Discover the UNESCO World Heritage Site of Stone Town with a guided walking tour through its labyrinth of alleyways, markets, and historic monuments. In the afternoon, visit a traditional spice farm to see, smell, and taste the spices that made Zanzibar famous. The day ends with a special Swahili dinner featuring local specialties.
Your Zanzibar journey comes to an end. Depending on your flight time, enjoy a final morning on the beach before our team transfers you to the airport. Kwaheri — until next time!

whatToBring: Modest clothing for Stone Town visits
pickupInfo: Airport pickup and drop-off included. Daily hotel pickup for all activities.
cancellationPolicyShort: Free cancellation up to 7 days before the start date.

seo.title: 7-Day Zanzibar Island Package | Zanzibar Heavenly
seo.description: Experience the best of Zanzibar in 7 days: Prison Island, dolphins, Safari Blue, Stone Town, spice farms, and The Rock Restaurant. All transfers and activities included.

content:
See the very best of Zanzibar in one week with this carefully crafted island package. Every day brings a new highlight — from swimming with dolphins at sunrise to dining at Africa’s most iconic ocean-perched restaurant.

This package packs in all of Zanzibar’s must-do experiences without feeling rushed. You’ll explore Stone Town’s living history, float on impossibly turquoise sandbanks, meet ancient tortoises, snorkel pristine reefs, and discover the spices that put this island on the map centuries ago. All transfers, entrance fees, and specified meals are included — so you can focus entirely on enjoying the island.

Whether you’re honeymooning, celebrating, or simply craving an unforgettable week of tropical adventure, this package covers all the essentials of the Zanzibar experience.
